name: Cartoon's Neighborhood
description: A cartoon comedy TV series in the United Arab Emirates that revolves around social and cultural values in the Emirati society.

videos.title: The Funeral
videos.overview: Umm Sayed cries over the death of her chicken, and it's revealed that it had to be killed because of the bird flu, so she holds a funeral for her.

videos.title: Horror Movie
videos.overview: Shambeeh tries to help a woman by exorcising her, so he places a firework in her mouth, killing her.

videos.title: Stock Market
videos.overview: Sabtu passes out after learning he lost all his money in the stock market when his stocks dropped.

videos.title: Appearances
videos.overview: Abu Salman tries to convince his friend that his car smells like sheep and is surprised when the shop owner fights with the owner of the fancy car for drinking cheap drinks and being a miser.

videos.title: Stranded on the Road
videos.overview: A man's car breaks down on the road and he tries to signal for help but no one stops. Later, a girl's car breaks down and he is shocked to see everybody stopping to help her.

videos.title: Shambeehariar
videos.overview: Shambeeh finds a lamp in the garbage, and imagines he'll be rich like Aladdin, but is surprised by the crazy genie inside the lamp.

videos.title: Fans
videos.overview: Shambeeh is watching his team play at the field, and keeps accusing the referee of taking a bribe.

videos.title: Wandering Camels
videos.overview: A man runs a camel over with his car when he finds another man looking for a camel to steal so he gives it to him.

videos.title: Fishing Trip
videos.overview: Shambeeh takes a fishing boat and meets Koti who sings for the fish to come to the surface and falls in the sea. He also sees a fisherman getting bitten by an eel.

videos.title: How to Hunt a Lizard
videos.overview: Hanafi tries to hunt a lizard, but the lizard gets into the car and presses on the gas pedal, causing an accident.

videos.title: The Business
videos.overview: Koti wants to open a business with his friend, and he decides to make sandwiches with flies. The police catch his oblivious friend who is innocent and Koti manages to escape.

videos.title: The Thief
videos.overview: Shambeeh is watching the match when a thief enters, asking for the living room and the keys to it. Shambeeh then helps him out and is shocked to see the server airing the match is destroyed.

videos.title: The Matchmaking Service
videos.overview: Shambeeh goes to a matchmaking service to get married, on the condition that for the first year, his wife lives with her parents and he goes to visit her on Thursdays and Fridays.

videos.title: The Coffee Shop
videos.overview: Hanafy invites his friend to have a drink at a cafe, where they meet a girl and invite her to sit with them and offer to pay for her order. Eventually, they end up washing dishes to cover their bill.

videos.title: The Honeymoon
videos.overview: Abu Salman and his wife take a flight to go on their honeymoon, where they run into Shambeeh, who goes to the toilet at the same time as Abu Salman wants to go, so he asks the pilot to stop anywhere so he can go.

videos.title: Learning the Bicycle
videos.overview: Koti has an accident with his bicycle, and Hanafy begs him not to call the police and he'll get him another one. However, he gets arrested.

videos.title: The Beauty Salon
videos.overview: Umm Salman goes to the beauty salon and is shocked when she sees a woman's hair on fire.

videos.title: The Gym
videos.overview: Hanafy goes to the gym, and his friend gives him supplements that turn him into a monster.

videos.title: Travel Sign
videos.overview: Shambeeh and Hanafy travel to Egypt and are abducted by a tribe.

videos.title: The Taxi
videos.overview: Shambeeh succeeds in fooling a taxi driver and not paying him, and the taxi driver has no other option but to let a passerby clean his car.

videos.title: The Advice
videos.overview: One of the boys tries to get to know a girl and give her his number, and later dreams of his grandfather scolding him.

videos.title: The Perfume
videos.overview: Hanafy goes to buy perfume for his fiancée, and is surprised to see her in the same store.

videos.title: The Foreign Player
videos.overview: Shambeeh brings a player from abroad for his team, and the player asks for 50 million euros, and Shambeeh keeps bargaining with him until it becomes 100 dirhams a month.

videos.title: The Time Machine
videos.overview: Hanafy's friend owns a car that can drive him to the past or the future, so he travels to Jahiliyyah (the pre-Islamic period) and makes fun of their idols.

videos.title: The Beach
videos.overview: Hanafy goes to the beach with his friend and keeps talking about his grandfather who fought the pirates.

videos.title: Breaking Fast Shambeeh
videos.overview: Umm Salman leaves a poisoned tuna for Shambeeh to eat for iftar, so he gets food poisoning.

videos.title: The Night Out
videos.overview: Abu Salman, his wife, and his son attend a concert of singer Abdallah Belkhair, and his wife insists he is not the famous singer.

videos.title: Eid's Kandora
videos.overview: Hanafy goes to the tailor and Shambeeh lies and tells him that Haifa the singer is outside, so he can take his turn. As a result, Hanafy and his friend throw a firework at Shambeeh's new clothes that tears them.

videos.title: Game Over
videos.overview: Koti is upset when his boss asks him to attend a meeting at Burj Al Arab because he lost the final level of the game he's playing.

videos.title: Fun Evening
videos.overview: Hanafy and his friends are stung by a swarm of bees.

videos.title: The Flirts
videos.overview: A guy disguises himself as a girl and deceives Shambeeh. Shambeeh takes his friend and decides to go out with the guy, who is surprised that he and his friends are not girls.

videos.title: Doctorate Degree
videos.overview: Ambaroh's friends blame him for deceiving his uncle and forging his passport. Umm Ambaroh (Ambaroh's mother) tells her son that his father was the reason for his uncle's insanity.

videos.title: Infiltration
videos.overview: As Shambeeh's sister visits her brother, Umm Salman watches them. When Abu Salman goes to Shambeeh's house and stays with him, Umm Salman hits him.

videos.title: The Kitchen
videos.overview: As Koti wants to set up a project with Othman, they are surprised to find Umm Sayed quarreling with one of the women who seek the help of the police, so Umm Sayed’s shop gets closed, which leads Hanafy to set fire to the woman’s shop.

videos.title: A Cloak
videos.overview: As Abu Salman tries to flirt with one of the girls in the mall, he mocks Umm Salman, who kicks him out of the house after his return, while Abu Ammar thinks that he has been possessed by a jinn; he freaks out when Othman's wife wears a cloak in the shape of a bat.

videos.title: The Haunted Car
videos.overview: As Shambeeh and his friends try to persuade Medhat to play cards with them, they misuse his name which makes him upset; they are surprised by his car moving without a driver.

videos.title: Swearing by Divorce
videos.overview: As Othman quarrels with his wife over beating her in the video game, he divorces her. He dreams of his grandfather who asks to find a muhallil (temporary husband) to marry his wife; he asks Shambeeh to marry her and then divorce her.

videos.title: Women Only
videos.overview: As Shambeeh and his friends plan to disguise themselves as women to attend a concert for women only, they get caught and beaten.

videos.title: Bangkok's Trip
videos.overview: As Shambeeh travels with his friends to Bangkok, they are surprised to find themselves in the middle of the jungle and there are people shooting at them from everywhere.

videos.title: The Haunted Farm
videos.overview: Shambeeh and his friend turn to a charlatan, who tells them that the farm is haunted and asks them to choose a strong person for a mission to enter the farm; they are surprised by Qamasah who marries the farm's ghost.

videos.title: School of the Rowdies
videos.overview: Shambeeh, Medhat, and their friends behave badly at school and smoke cigarettes.

videos.title: Love Dumpster
videos.overview: As Koti likes the maid, he starts seeing her by the dumpster. Ambaroh and his friends take pictures of him and threaten Koti with it if he doesn't do their demands.

videos.title: Cressida Turbo
videos.overview: Hanafy tries to persuade Othman to sell his Cressida car, but he refuses, so they destroy it for him to force him to sell it.

videos.title: Um Sulaiman's Shoes
videos.overview: As Um Sulaiman buys new shoes, they make her feet get very swollen.

videos.title: Hanafi for Amoun and Amoun for Hanafi
videos.overview: As Hanafy is upset when Amoun sits in the cafe, he tells her that their parents betrothed her to him when they were young.

videos.title: The Accident
videos.overview: Amoun seeks help from her brother Ambaroh after someone tries to harass her with the car, causing an accident.

videos.title: Administrative Coach
videos.overview: As a football match will be held between Shaabiat Al Cartoon team and another team, Coach Abu Ambaroh takes over leading the team of Shaabiat Al Cartoon by interfering as an administrator in the team's training; the team ends up losing.

videos.title: Pleasant Gathering
videos.overview: As Sayed and his friends decide to take a trip, they listen to many songs on their soiree.

videos.title: The Smelly
videos.overview: Sabtu tells horror stories to Sayed and Amoun, and when Othman disappears, Sayed thinks that the ghost whom Sabtu talked about is the one who kidnapped him, whom he called Abu Riha.

videos.title: Koti Is Your Man
videos.overview: As Umm Sayed is upset about her son's obesity, she asks Sabtu to help her get a liposuction procedure for him, but she suggests that he turns to Captain Koti to help him lose weight.

videos.title: Encrypted Channels
videos.overview: Othman's grandfather asks Shambeeh to help him prevent Othman from staying up late in front of the encrypted channels. But Shambeeh ends up watching the channels with him, so the grandfather cuts off the transmission from the satellite.

videos.title: Hidden Camera
videos.overview: As Hanafy tells his friends that he's filming a movie with Leonardo DiCaprio, he gets Umm Salman and his wife in trouble after falsely claiming that he is cheating on her; he eventually tells them that he is filming the candid camera.

videos.title: The Addicts
videos.overview: As Sayed returns from travel, Hanafy and everyone welcome him back. As he smokes with Shambeeh and his friends, they are surprised that he smokes drugs.

videos.title: You Have a Penny, You're Worth a Penny
videos.overview: Shambeeh is surprised by a call from the bank informing him that he inherited a large sum of money from his Brazilian grandfather. As he begins to treat everyone arrogantly, he gets engaged to Amoun, only for the bank to tell him that there was a mixup with the names.

videos.title: Encrypted Channels
videos.overview: As a program about quackery and sorcery is shown on one of the satellite channels, everyone calls it to ask for strange things.

videos.title: New Year's Bulb
videos.overview: As Othman decides to buy a bulb to turn off on New Year's Eve, Shambeeh is upset that he is alone, so his friends help him marry four women and give him a bulb.

videos.title: Pearls
videos.overview: Othman tells Shambeeh that his wife asked him for real pearls, or else she will divorce him, so Shambeeh helps him search for it in the depths of the sea.

videos.title: Ramadan's Business
videos.overview: Shambeeh's mother convinces her son to help her to do business in Ramadan, which is begging throughout the month.

videos.title: The Goat Metwali
videos.overview: Abu Salman decides to buy a goat from Medhat who tells them that he breeds his sheep the best way. As Umm Salman insists on buying the goat Metwally, Medhat refuses.

videos.title: Bloopers
videos.overview: The episode includes many behind-the-scenes footage during the filming of the series' episodes.

videos.title: Puffy Sheila
videos.overview: A fierce challenge is taking place between Amoun and the neighborhood women over who is the owner of the largest "Gamboa'a" in the neighborhood!! And this conflict ends on the head of Umm Suleiman, who pays the price with her hair!!

videos.title: Man of a Good Will
videos.overview: Shambaih receives an anonymous call from (a benefactor) in the middle of the night, telling him that he is afflicted with magic, and in order to unlock this magic, he must send a sum of money through a transfer to an African country. It is nothing more than a mere (Scam)!!

videos.title: Atouqa
videos.overview: Atouqa enters the coffee shop with her close friend Amoun. They dont find any empty tables to set at. At that moment, Atouqa pushes Caroline away from the table she was sitting at, and a verbal altercation breaks out between them.. Hanafi, Ambro, Dahim, and Yama'an Kankari intervene to defend Caroline (as a matter of magnanimity, chivalry, and manhood), and of course they will pay the price for this (magnanimity) at the hands of Atouqa!!

videos.title: The Hostage
videos.overview: The motorcycle that Afari and her brother Muhair were riding falls on the roof of Atouqa's car, causing it to smash. The two young children run away to hide in their father's estate, followed by Atouqa, who arrives at the estate and takes Bu Muhair's camel with her as a hostage until he repairs her car!!

videos.title: The Cooking Pot
videos.overview: Shambaih suggests to his friend Bu Muhair that he cook food for his guests on one occasion for a small amount of money, instead of assigning one of the popular kitchens that will take a huge amount from him. He couldn't get the pot out of the door, which puts Bu Muhair in embarrassing trouble with his guests!!

videos.title: Zombie
videos.overview: A mysterious disease and epidemic spreads in the neighborhood, after Hanafi devours the (Molokhia) with the rabbit who had drank from the contaminated water..which results in the transmission of the contagious disease to Hanafi who bites his friend Dahim, and he in turn transmits it to all members of the neighborhood who bite each other!!

videos.title: The License
videos.overview: Shambaih suffers from not obtaining a (license) in his transfers from one place to another, as everyone humiliates him while they drive him in their cars..then he decides at that moment to rely on himself and obtain a (license) in order to end his tragedies, which will increase after obtaining a (license)!!

videos.title: Secret Marriage
videos.overview: After watching the broadcaster in a satellite channel Caroline and his fondness of her, Bu Muhair decides to marry her after Shambaih convinces him to do so, but on the condition that the marriage be (secret) to avoid the evil of his wife, Um Muhair.

videos.title: Private Evening
videos.overview: The neighborhood elders stay up in the mainland, an (innocent) evening around the fire and the moonlight, until a four-wheel drive car carrying a number of safari tourists comes to them and asks to sit with them and share with them their tanning session, which turned into a (private evening), all the details of which were seen by Um Suleiman, who is watching her husband Always through satellite and pay for it after coming home!!

videos.title: I Am a Human
videos.overview: There is nothing beyond patience but relief. This is what happened with the Sri Lankan maid, Rita.

videos.title: Keep the Place Clean
videos.overview: The municipal inspector pursues the Cartoon neighborhood in order to preserve the environment.

videos.title: Have Mercy on Mumtaz
videos.overview: Mumtaz, the Pakistani driver, escapes from Shambaih, who is chasing him everywhere.

videos.title: Private Lessons
videos.overview: Professor Zinhum and the effect of the private lessons he gives to students.

videos.title: Um Khanor Battle
videos.overview: The officer is interrogating the neighborhood elders with swollen faces, who claim to have been beaten in the Umm Khanour area.

videos.title: 70's Neighborhood
videos.overview: In this episode, we will see the residents of the Cartoon Neighborhood Shambaih, Bu Muhair, Bu Amber, Bo Suleiman, Osman, Kuti, Um Sayed, Um Suleiman, Saptoh and her father (Sbait)..We will go back in time to see them when they were children, and what they did at that stage!!

videos.title: Cinema
videos.overview: Shambaih wants to get married, so Bu Muhair takes him to the cinema to choose a wife.

videos.title: Tomato
videos.overview: Bu Mohamad and Shambaih partner in the business of trading (tomatoes).

videos.title: Prices on Fire
videos.overview: Residents of Cartoon Neighborhood abandon the city to live in the desert, far from the fire of prices that have burned everything.

videos.title: Garage
videos.overview: The story of Bu Suleiman's suffering with the malfunctions of his pink pick-up

videos.title: Abu Saffa
videos.overview: In this episode, we will see the story of the genie (Abu Saffa), who was planted by Afari, daughter of Bu Muhair, in Osman's head which chased him everywhere.

videos.title: Souq Nayef
videos.overview: Who is behind the fire that broke out in Nayef market?

videos.title: Summer Course
videos.overview: The Cartoon's Neighborhood elders take their youth with them on a cruiser to the sea during the summer vacation to teach them how to fish, given that they are in a (summer course)

videos.title: Neighborhood Idol (1)
videos.overview: The Cartoon's Neighborhood characters participate in the singing competition (Neighborhood Idol), and each of them dreams of winning and becoming a star.

videos.title: Neighborhood Idol (2)
videos.overview: The Cartoon's Neighborhood characters participate in the singing competition (Neighborhood Idol), and each of them dreams of winning and becoming a star.

videos.title: Garbage Siege
videos.overview: Garbage besieges the Cartoon's Neighborhood because of the consumption system of its residents, and from there begins the attack of rats and insects on the homes and people of the  neighborhood.

videos.title: Trouble Profession
videos.overview: Shambaih works as a sports reporter for (Emirates Today) newspaper in order to travel to cover sporting events, and with his first official assignment he travels to Oman to cover bullfighting.

videos.title: Investors
videos.overview: Shambaih did not understand the meaning of "taking profits" because of which he lost all his savings in the stock market.

videos.title: The Groom
videos.overview: Residents of the Cartoon's Neighborhood are on the road on a bus, going to Oman for the engagement of (Jashaa) the niece of Um Suleiman and Yama'an Kankari.

videos.title: Abu Sabri in Australia
videos.overview: Bu Muhair has been searching for his lost camel for years, and he learned that he is now in Australia and married to an Australian two-humped camel!!

videos.title: Times Square Date
videos.overview: Dahim, Hanafi and Ambro are in a love (prank) on a date with Bu Suleiman in Times Square Mall.

videos.title: Welcome Ramadan
videos.overview: With the advent of the month of Ramadan, Bu Muhair goes to one of his rich friends to congratulate him on this occasion. And of course, Shambaih accompanies him in order to collect (Zakat) from him!!

videos.title: The Victim
videos.overview: Sayed (Hanafi's brother from the mother) turns into a victim and a wanderer in the streets, after his divorced parents, Um Sayed and Mr. Zainhom, abandon him. Shambaih picks him up and embraces him, introducing him to the world of car thefts.

videos.title: Grandma Fatto
videos.overview: Dahim's grandmother, Grandma Fatto, arrives from Jeddah, and turns the life of her grandson Dahim into bliss with the money she owns, until Shambaih causes a problem between them and Dahim returns once again to poverty.

videos.title: Cheer the Camels
videos.overview: Shaimabig is in charge of the remote control that drives the (automatic rugby) sitting on the back of the Bu Muhair's camel that participates in the camel race, after Bu Muhair promised that the grand prize would be his share.

videos.title: Apartment for Rent
videos.overview: Shambaih is looking for an apartment for his nephew in Dubai and Sharjah, but he can't find one because of the high cost, until he finds a home that fits his budget in Al Dhaid area which is overlooking the cemeteries!!

videos.title: Send to Jaheliya (1)
videos.overview: Yama'an Kankari invents a technology via a laptop that sends an email that carries people to different times, including the pre-Islamic era, when Abu Jahl's character is summoned!!

videos.title: Send to Jaheliya (2)
videos.overview: Yama'an Kankari invents a technology via a laptop that sends an email that carries people to different times, including the pre-Islamic era, when Abu Jahl's character is summoned!!

videos.title: Association Money
videos.overview: A number of popular characters participate in making (an association) that distributes its money every month to one of them, until one of them is accused of stealing the association's money and escaping with it.

videos.title: The Rumor
videos.overview: A rumor spread by Suleiman's mother causes many problems for Amoon, Dahim and Hanafi.

videos.title: Summer Interns
videos.overview: Amoon and Atouqa train in one of the departments in the summer, and the director distinguishes between them in his dealings, as he allocates an office next to his office for the beautiful Amoon, while Atouqa sits under the stairs!!

videos.title: Singles Housing
videos.overview: Shambaih enters into an existential struggle against the Asian singles who live in the neighborhood. Either he is stays in the neighborhood, or they do!!

videos.title: Security
videos.overview: Thieves steal Osman's house, so Shambaih is worried that his house will be stolen next time, so he takes precautions and installs an electronic security system for the house to prevent thieves from entering.

videos.title: Your Help, Homeland
videos.overview: Shambaih convinces Bu Muhair to finance a business project that he will manage, and the project is a store that sells mobile phones and ringtones.

videos.title: Youth Talk
videos.overview: Shambaih decides to get married, so he consults the youth of the people about the art of catching the bride from the malls, and they plot for him a number of ways which will implicate him.

videos.title: Retirement
videos.overview: Shambaih is retired, and he embarks on a journey of searching for another job, but he does not find it, until he finds a job for him that he can only dream about, which is a dancer in a (Liwa) troupe.

videos.title: The Boy is Our Boy
videos.overview: Hanafi proposes to Amoon, so her parents Bu Amber and Sabtoh demand a high dowry and many other requests that burden Hanafi’s shoulders, and they explain to him that they did not ask him for anything much because he is considered one of their children!!

videos.title: Scholars However
videos.overview: The scientist Yama'an Kankari participates in an international scientific conference, and a scientific breakthrough is revealed, which is that the days of the year have been shortened!!

videos.title: Shambaih's Debts
videos.overview: Shambaih is chasing his friends from the elders of the neighborhood in order to pay off the money they borrowed from him previously, and after the account is cleared, he discovers that he owes them many times what he is asking them for!!

videos.title: Lost
videos.overview: The elders of the Cartoon's Neighborhood get lost on an isolated island in the middle of the sea, and after patience and trouble they are rescued.

videos.title: Domestic Violence
videos.overview: The story of Ambroh's suffering, who grew up between his father, Bu Amber, who treated him violently, and his mother, Saptoh, who spoiled him too much. Domestic violence increases in the families of Bu Muhair and Bu Amber, who chose Shambaih as their family advisor.

videos.title: Al Maidan
videos.overview: A number of popular cartoon characters are participating in (Al-Maidan) competition for Al-Youlah in order to win the prize.

videos.title: Statistics
videos.overview: The adventures of the employees of the Statistics Center Khaled and Omar, who enter the Cartoon's Neighborhood and the Bricks Neighborhood in order to do population statistics.

videos.title: Endowment
videos.overview: Shambaih's suffering with (beggars) who are chasing him, asking him to donate to them.

videos.title: Offenders
videos.overview: The story of the suffering of the worker (Sico Five), who was sponsored by Bu Amber, and then left him to work in several jobs far from him, as a violation of the work and residence law.

videos.title: People's Satisfaction
videos.overview: Shambaih and Osman work in an office for clearing transactions under Afari's management.

videos.title: Food Poisoning
videos.overview: Shambaih gets food poisoning due to not following food safety instructions.

videos.title: Stadium Riot (1)
videos.overview: In a derby match between Cartoon's Neighborhood and Bricks Neighborhood, a lot of incidents and riots take place between the fans of the two teams.

videos.title: Stadium Riot (2)
videos.overview: In a derby match between Cartoon's Neighborhood and Bricks Neighborhood, a lot of incidents and riots take place between the fans of the two teams.

videos.title: Ramadan's Nuts
videos.overview: As Shambeeh tries to convince everyone around him that he sees the crescent of Ramadan with his telescope, he and those around him begin to struggle as they fast, trying to adapt to it.

videos.title: Dhaen
videos.overview: Shambeeh suffers from the mockery of those around him because of his strange name, so he decides to go to the relevant governmental authority to change his name, but soon he discovers that it’s not about names.

videos.title: Antar & Atooga 1
videos.overview: Amoun and Atuqa go on a safari, where the duo encounter many dangers, until they find a stone that grants wishes, so Atuqa wishes to go to a time where there’s true love, whereupon they find themselves in the era of Antar and Abla.

videos.title: Antar & Atooga 2
videos.overview: As Abla's father puts many obstacles in Antar’s way in order to marry her, Atuqa eventually discovers that love does not exist at any time.

videos.title: Swine Flu
videos.overview: Zainabo gets a divorce ruling and custody of the child, whereupon she takes him to the hospital after he got sick, only to find out that he has the newly discovered swine flu, causing everyone around to panic.

videos.title: Hanafy Show
videos.overview: Hanafy gets the opportunity to present and direct a show based on his idea, and he decides to execute the idea on those close to him with a hidden camera and pranks show.

videos.title: People in Life are Different
videos.overview: When Shambeeh flirts with a beautiful woman, she laughs as a kind of mockery at his appearance, so he thinks that she likes him and decides to propose to her, but soon finds out the truth and is filled with regret.

videos.title: Violence
videos.overview: After getting into trouble, Ambaroh is taken to the police station, and begins to recall his father's violence towards him from a young age and his mother's pampering him, which caused him to grow up in an environment full of contradictions.

videos.title: Fireworks
videos.overview: Shambeeh can’t sleep due to the noise caused by children using crackers, so he comes up with a trick to put an end to it, but soon it backfires.

videos.title: Unintentional Mistake
videos.overview: Abu Suleiman devises a plan to marry Sabtu before her death to inherit all her possessions, so he tries to convince Umm Suleiman of her inability to conceive and the necessity of his marriage, only for the tests to reveal that he is infertile, but soon it’s revealed that the tests were wrong.

videos.title: Figure it out
videos.overview: Bu Mhayer travels, leaving Shambeeh in charge of his business and his children, asking him to behave well, but when he returns, he finds Shambeeh has ruined everything and sold all his camels.

videos.title: The Secret Store
videos.overview: The women try to find out the secret place where Amoun buys her clothes and refuses to disclose, so they set out on an adventure to follow her in the hope of finding the secret store, but soon they have an accident on the road.

videos.title: Um Sayed's Marriage
videos.overview: As Hanafy decides to marry, his father appears to him in a dream and tells him that he must help his mother Umm Sayed marry first, so he seeks a sorcerer's help to look for a suitor for his mother, but Umm Sayed resorts to the judiciary, rejecting her son's demands.

videos.title: Karak
videos.overview: Atuqa and Koti’s disputes cause her to wish to enter the field of trading and to control the masala chai in the market, whereupon she decides to create a business venture similar to the idea of the movie ‘Avatar’.

videos.title: The Sheep
videos.overview: Bu Mhayer listens to some advice to buy a new sheep to improve his animals’ offspring, so he buys the sheep but ends up cooking it for a banquet.

videos.title: Nana Zahra
videos.overview: When Nana Zahra, Shambeeh’s aunt, comes from her country to stay with the family, everyone goes on a family trip, which ends disastrously before Nana returns home.

videos.title: Shambeeh's Dream
videos.overview: Shambeeh begins implementing his new project, building a gas station to fulfill his father's dream. He discovers that he can win a car from scratchcards. Bu Mhayer wins the prize while Shambeeh gets a donkey cart.

videos.title: Umm Suleiman's Salted Fish
videos.overview: As Umm Salem complains about the disappearance of salted fish from her barrels, she suspects that there is a jinn stealing them, whereupon everyone tries to find out the truth, until it’s revealed that Shambeeh stole the fish to eat them.

videos.title: eLife
videos.overview: Sabtu discovers the iLive service to watch new shows and movies, and asks Abu Ambaroh to subscribe to it, and when he refuses, she asks for a divorce, but they end up being reconciled and he fulfills her request, but in a different way.

videos.title: The Warlock
videos.overview: As Atuqa suspects that she has been a victim of witchcraft and a warlock’s attempt to control her, she goes to a sorcerer, hoping he’ll help her. He tells her that she needs to look for those she’s wronged and reconcile with them in order for the problem to end.

videos.title: O Lord, Keep Us Safe
videos.overview: Mhayer gets acquainted with a mysterious person online, and as he goes to meet him, he discovers that he is a criminal, who kidnapps him, upon which Bu Mhayer intervenes and rescues his son.

videos.title: Mhayer Is Missing
videos.overview: When Bu Mhayer asks his son Mhayer to park the car inside the house, the latter takes the car and goes out with his friends, whereupon he gets arrested for driving without a license, and the matter develops as the police accuse Bu Mhayer and his son of human trafficking.

videos.title: Making Airplane Parts
videos.overview: Since everyone's obsessed with flying, Abbas ibn Firnas appears to them and tries to convince them to experiment with flying with artificial wings, so Yamaan decides to implement the idea, which fails, but he escapes death.

videos.title: Renew
videos.overview: Abu Suleiman ignores the notices about Sabtu’s passport renewal, and prepares with his family to travel on a summer vacation, but the trip ends before it begins when they discover that Sabtu’s passport has expired.

videos.title: The One with Ears Cigarettes
videos.overview: Mhayer and Deheem get involved with Yamaan, who invented a healthy cigarette that emits smoke through the ears, not the mouth, and the team begins distributing the new invention before the police discover the matter and arrest them.

videos.title: International Communication Offer
videos.overview: As Stu Ftu falls ill, Shambeeh fears that she will die and that her maid will get her entire fortune. Shambeeh tries to trick Stu Ftu to get her fortune, but soon the doctor tells them that she is in good health.

videos.title: Behind the Scenes
videos.overview: The Shaabiat Al Cartoon team gathers at the end to reveal the many behind-the-scenes details about their characters.
